description: One-Time Codes are PAUSED and cannot be bought; this only works for orders placed before the pause. Poll a purchased One-Time Code order for its SMS code. Returns the phone number and, once it arrives, the verification code. Call repeatedly (every few seconds) until phase is code_ready or failed. Pass the ak_live_ api key and the order_id from purchase_one_time_code.

api_key.description: The ak_live_ key returned by create_wallet. Pass it here, or as an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: get_one_time_code
